kpis.name: AI Governance and Compliance
kpis.explanation: Implementation of an AI governance framework and an automated regulatory monitoring platform
kpis.description: GSK has established a Responsible AI governance framework and an advanced AI platform to automate monitoring of global regulatory changes. The AI Governance Council oversees the integrity of safeguards during AI system deployments, including autonomous agent systems, with mandatory security controls and human oversight.

kpis.name: Cybersecurity Maturity
kpis.explanation: Achievement of cybersecurity maturity targets positioned in the top quartile of peers
kpis.description: GSK delivered all objectives and commitments of the Multi-Year Cybersecurity Plan (updated in 2022, benchmarked against NIST-CSF) by end-2025. Top quartile peer positioning was achieved. Transition to a threat-informed continuous defense program through 2028.

ai_positioning.summary: GSK integrates AI in a governed manner to enhance its regulatory compliance processes, research capabilities, and commercial operations, while maintaining strict guardrails and human oversight.
evidence: Advanced AI platform to automate monitoring of global regulatory changes
Responsible AI governance framework with dedicated AI Governance Council
Enhanced security controls for agentic AI systems with protocolized escalation
Internal audit covering AI system management in R&D laboratories
